protocol.primary_measure: Unsupported supplied claims asserted as facts, divided by a fixed count of unsupported input claims; unresolved readings are not treated as clean.

Base receives textual source tags just like Text-SFT; source information is not deliberately withheld.

protocol.training_selection: Both fresh models train exactly 200 steps over the same 200 pairs. No test-based extra steps or checkpoint selection.
